help.title: Help
help.about_description: A visual GUI tool for managing OpenCode and Oh My OpenCode configuration files
help.author: Author
help.priority_content:
1. Remote Configuration
   Configuration obtained through API or remote server
   Highest priority, overrides all local configurations

2. Global Configuration
   Location: ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json
   Default configuration affecting all projects

3. Custom Configuration
   Configuration file specified via --config parameter
   Used for specific scenario configuration overrides

4. Project Configuration
   Location: <project root>/opencode.json
   Project-level configuration, affects current project only

5. .opencode Directory Configuration
   Location: <project root>/.opencode/config.json
   Hidden configuration directory within project

6. Inline Configuration
   Configuration specified directly via command line parameters
   Lowest priority, but most flexible

Configuration Merge Rules:
- Higher priority configurations override lower priority ones with the same name
- Unspecified configuration items inherit values from lower priorities
- Provider and Model configurations are deeply merged
help.usage_content:
1. Provider Management
   Add custom API providers
   Configure API addresses and keys
   Support multiple SDKs: @ai-sdk/anthropic, @ai-sdk/openai, etc.

2. Model Management
   Add models under Provider
   Support quick selection of preset common models
   Configure model parameters (context limits, output limits, etc.)

3. Agent Management (Oh My OpenCode)
   Configure Agents for different purposes
   Bind configured Provider/Model
   Support preset Agent templates

4. Category Management (Oh My OpenCode)
   Configure task categories
   Set Temperature for different categories
   Bind corresponding models

5. Permission Management
   Configure tool usage permissions
   allow: Allow usage
   ask: Ask each time
   deny: Deny usage

6. External Import
   Detect configurations from Claude Code and other tools
   One-click import of existing configurations

Notes:
- Please click Save button after modifications
- Recommend regular backup of configuration files
- Agent/Category models must be configured Provider/Model
help.options_content:
According to OpenCode official documentation:

【Options】Default configuration parameters for models
- These configurations are used every time the model is called
- Suitable for common fixed configurations
- Example: thinking.type, thinking.budgetTokens

【Variants】Switchable variant configurations
- Users can switch via variant_cycle shortcut
- Suitable for different scenario configuration combinations
- Example: high/medium/low different budgetTokens

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Thinking Mode Configuration Examples
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

【Claude】
  options:
    thinking:
      type: "enabled"
      budgetTokens: 16000
  variants:
    high:
      thinking:
        budgetTokens: 32000
    max:
      thinking:
        budgetTokens: 64000

【OpenAI】
  options:
    reasoningEffort: "high"
  variants:
    medium:
      reasoningEffort: "medium"
    low:
      reasoningEffort: "low"

【Gemini】
  options:
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingBudget: 8000
  variants:
    high:
      thinkingConfig:
        thinkingBudget: 16000

tooltip.provider_name:
Provider Name - Unique identifier for this provider
Format: lowercase letters and hyphens, e.g. anthropic, openai, my-proxy
tooltip.provider_display:
Display Name - Friendly name shown in the UI
Example: Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI Official
tooltip.provider_sdk:
SDK Package - Specifies which AI SDK to use for API calls
• Claude series -> @ai-sdk/anthropic
• GPT/OpenAI series -> @ai-sdk/openai
• Gemini series -> @ai-sdk/google
tooltip.provider_url:
API URL (baseURL) - API service access address
• Official API -> Leave empty (auto-uses default)
• Proxy -> Fill in proxy address
tooltip.provider_apikey:
API Key - Authentication key
Supports env variable: {env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}
tooltip.provider_timeout:
Request Timeout - Unit: milliseconds (ms)
Default: 300000 (5 minutes)
tooltip.model_id:
Model ID - Unique identifier, must match API provider
Example: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, gpt-5
tooltip.model_name: Display Name - Friendly name shown in the UI
tooltip.model_attachment: Attachment Support - Whether file uploads (images, documents, etc.) are supported
tooltip.model_context: Context Window - Maximum input length the model can process (tokens)
tooltip.model_output: Max Output - Maximum reply length per response (tokens)
tooltip.model_options:
Model Default Config (Options) - Parameters automatically applied to every model call
• Claude thinking: thinking.type, thinking.budgetTokens
• OpenAI: reasoningEffort, textVerbosity
• Gemini: thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget
tooltip.model_variants:
Model Variants - Preset config combinations switchable via hotkey
Used for different configurations of the same model, e.g. different thinking budgets
tooltip.agent_name:
Agent Name - Unique identifier
Preset Agents: oracle, librarian, explore, code-reviewer
tooltip.agent_model:
Bound Model - Format: provider/model-id
Example: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929
tooltip.agent_description: Agent Description - Describes the agent's function and use cases
tooltip.opencode_agent_mode:
Agent Mode
• primary - Main Agent, switchable via Tab
• subagent - Sub Agent, invoked via @mention
• all - Both modes supported
tooltip.opencode_agent_temperature:
Generation Temperature - Range: 0.0 - 2.0
• 0.0-0.2: Suited for code/analysis
• 0.3-0.5: Balances creativity and accuracy
tooltip.opencode_agent_maxSteps:
Max Steps - Limits the number of tool calls an Agent can make
Empty = unlimited
tooltip.opencode_agent_prompt:
System Prompt - Defines Agent behavior and expertise
Supports file reference: {file:./prompts/agent.txt}
tooltip.opencode_agent_tools:
Tool Config - JSON object format
• true - Enable tool
• false - Disable tool
tooltip.opencode_agent_permission:
Permission Config
• allow - Allow without confirmation
• ask - Ask user each time
• deny - Deny usage
tooltip.opencode_agent_hidden:
Hidden - Whether to hide this Agent in @ autocomplete
Only effective for subagent
tooltip.category_name:
Category Name
Preset categories: visual, business-logic, documentation, code-analysis
tooltip.category_description: Category Description - Explains the category's purpose and use cases
tooltip.permission_tool:
Tool Name
Built-in: Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, WebSearch, Task
MCP format: mcp_servername_toolname
tooltip.permission_level:
Permission Level
• allow - Use directly without confirmation
• ask - Ask user before each use
• deny - Deny usage
tooltip.permission_bash_pattern:
Bash Command Pattern - Supports wildcards
• * - Match all commands
• git * - Match all git commands
tooltip.mcp_name:
MCP Name - Unique identifier for MCP server
Example: context7, sentry, gh_grep
tooltip.mcp_type:
MCP Type
• local - Local process, started via command
• remote - Remote service, connected via URL
tooltip.mcp_enabled:
Enabled - Whether this MCP server is enabled
Disabled preserves config but doesn't load
tooltip.mcp_command:
Start Command (Local type) - JSON array format
Example: ["npx", "-y", "@mcp/server"]
tooltip.mcp_url: Server URL (Remote type) - Full HTTP/HTTPS URL
tooltip.mcp_headers:
Request Headers (Remote type) - JSON object format
Example: {"Authorization": "Bearer your-api-key"}
tooltip.mcp_environment:
Environment Variables (Local type) - JSON object format
Example: {"API_KEY": "xxx"}
tooltip.skill_name:
Skill Name - 1-64 chars, lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens
Example: git-release, pr-review
tooltip.skill_permission:
Skill Permission
• allow - Load immediately without confirmation
• deny - Hide and deny access
• ask - Ask user before loading
tooltip.skill_pattern:

tooltip.skill_description: Skill Description - Describes the Skill's function, helps Agent choose
tooltip.instructions_path: Instructions File Path - Supports relative/absolute paths, Glob patterns, remote URLs
tooltip.rules_agents_md:
